An '''Imperial base''' on [[Jondora/Legends|Jondora]] was a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] weapons from the base were illegally sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Profiteering}}</ref>
